subject.title: fix(auth): decouple plugin synthetic-auth from profile fallback for gateway attempts (#110103)

question: After a rebase and completed CI, should the gateway auth contract explicitly permit eligible provider-plugin synthetic authentication independently of stored auth-profile fallback?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive change to shared provider credential resolution, and repository inspection was unavailable to establish whether current `main` has a preferred prepared-auth boundary or an intentional contrary behavior.

options.title: Accept the isolated synthetic-auth contract
options.body: Rebase and merge once current-head checks pass and the auth owner confirms that eligible plugin synthetic credentials must remain reachable on gateway-isolated attempts.

options.title: Use another prepared-auth seam
options.body: Request a narrower design if current main already exposes a supported route-specific credential capability that avoids adding shared resolver parameters.

recommendation.title: Accept the isolated synthetic-auth contract
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge once current-head checks pass and the auth owner confirms that eligible plugin synthetic credentials must remain reachable on gateway-isolated attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the implementation and can supply an updated rebase and proof; ownership of the corresponding current-main subsystem could not be independently established.
